evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief is a full multi-role transactional product, not a stub. instruction.md:1-3 asks for saved coordinated previews, all-or-nothing commit, stale-preview refusal including restored balances, and idempotent retry returning the original receipt after later revisions, rescissions or a server restart; instruction.md:5 keeps the offer desk (requisitions, pending offers, tiered approvals, exact equity valuation, signing adjustments, referrals, rescission clawbacks) and six views; instruction.md:7-11 add pre-save figures, 2-4 members, 15-second self-update, per-user unsent entries and read-only what-if; instruction.md:15 requires Node/Express/SQLite with a durable database. There is no starter app to tweak: environment/Dockerfile:17-23 creates /app containing only .gitkeep. The reward cannot be earned by a static page, mock or single CRUD screen: gates/render/judge.toml criterion hro_gate_render states 'A static login/workspace picture or only a health response is insufficient'; gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared requires UI creation of a requisition plus PENDING offer read back in an independent browser context and states 'A static seed response, no-op success message, browser-only mutation or requisition-only app does not satisfy the gate'; tests/tools/score.py sets reward 0.0 unless both gates and the floor pass, and tests/scoring.toml sets functional floor 0.05 (strict >). scored/functional/prompt.md:15 gives every binary criterion 0 for a blank/static shell; visual/prompt.md:12 and polish/prompt.md:12 apply the same backend check, so appearance alone earns nothing. Weak-app arithmetic from the 152 functional weights (sum 74.0): a gate-only intake CRUD with sign-in could reach roughly requisition/offer creation and raise-role rows 0.3%, date-only 0.24%, intake validation 0.24%, anonymous requisition/offer read and write refusals about 0.5%, i.e. about 1.3%; adding all five P3 computed displays (3.25%) gives about 4.5%, still under the 0.05 floor, so reward 0. The coordinated-change and change-desk groups (B, D, L, E, R plus the P10 replay row) carry about 77% of functional weight and all five polish criteria depend on the coordinated-change desk, so a trivial extension of an offer desk also cannot reach a high reward. Negative rows demand a successful control first (functional/prompt.md:21, :29 'Try valid neighboring values afterward so nonfunctional forms cannot earn negative credit', :45), so a dead feature does not collect refusal credit. Conforming-alternative check: gates and prompts forbid requiring routes, selectors, labels or ID formats, and an empty operational desk is accepted (instruction.md:17, gates/render criterion), so a genuine build with a different layout is not excluded by this row. Residual risk: the weak-app figures above are derived from source weights, not measured. raw-evidence-index.json states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and target/Oracle scores are absent'; no configured judge run on a stub or weakened app exists for these bytes, so the claim that a stub earns 0 is unmeasured. Minor observation outside a defect for this row: an offer desk without any coordinated-change feature that clears the floor could still collect visual Likert credit (weight 0.2), because the visual criteria name the coordinated-change workspace but the visual prompt has no explicit rule for an absent surface; that app is still a real working build, so it does not breach this check.
